A '''male Human''' with [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], a beard, brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and fair skin served as a henchman to [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. He was present in the Hutt's [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="Blog" /> by [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']] to the beginning of [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> around the [[Time/Legends|time]] period where several [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] operatives [[Siege of Jabba's Palace|arrived]] to bargain for the freedom of fellow Rebel [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], who was held [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] in the palace.<ref name="RotJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:EndorStrikeTeam.jpg|thumb|left|100px|The cut Jabba's Palace extra was officially established as a Rebel commando in several sources]]
The bearded extra who would be established in-universe as a Rebel commando was originally set to appear onset for the [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] scenes in the [[1983]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], although he was cut from the final film itself.<ref name="Blog" /> The character was visible in the documentary ''[[Classic Creatures: Return of the Jedi]]'' which gave a behind the scenes look at the film.<ref name="Classic Creatures">''[[Classic Creatures: Return of the Jedi]]''</ref> Subsequent reference photographs of the character in costume were mislabeled as "Rebel commando,"<ref name="Blog" /> with [[1999]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Action Figure Archive]]'' being the first [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] source to depict him as such in-universe.<ref name="Action Figure Archive">''[[Star Wars: The Action Figure Archive]]''</ref>

In early [[2013]], the ''[[Star Wars]]'' author [[Pablo Hidalgo]] grew suspicious of the character's identification with a Rebel commando due to his long robes and resolutely non-standard helmet and boots, though initially noting the character's outfit being similar to the Rebel commandos' camouflage pattern. While watching ''Classic Creatures: Return of the Jedi'' on the [[Wikipedia:Blu-ray Disc|Blu-ray]] edition of ''Star Wars'': Episode VI, Hidalgo spotted the character on the set of Jabba's [[Throne/Legends|throne]] room. On [[March 5]], 2013, Hidalgo posted an article on [[StarWars.com]]'s [[Star Wars Blog|official blog]] recounting how he rediscovered the character's original identity. In that weblog entry, Hidalgo also postulated that the character may still be seen in ''Return of the Jedi'', lurking in the background in the shot where [[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]] tries to stop [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] from entering Jabba's throne room. While Hidalgo subsequently had the "Rebel commando" label associated with photos of the extra pulled from the official image archives,<ref name="Blog" /> this article assumes the character's prior in-universe identification as a Rebel commando as canon, as there is nothing contradictory with other material.
